segments.name: Wire harness
segments.description: Makes cable and wire harnesses and connectors for customers in Europe, Asia and the Americas.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that it only has one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for product sales of cable and wire harnesses and connectors, mostly to Europe, Asia and the Americas.
revenueModel.evidence: The majority of the Group's revenue for the years ended March 31, 2026, 2025 and 2024 was generated from product sales to different geographic areas including Europe, Asia and Americas.
